Either.

www.vekn.net/2-uncategorised/378-vampire-elder-kindred-network-newsletter-july-2017
Q: When do I lock The Line to reduce the cost of the action card?

A: You can lock it when you announce the action (for instance, if your vampire couldn't pay for the card otherwise), or anytime during the action. This works the same way as Sunset Strip, Hollywood. If the action card is canceled as it is announced, The Line isn't locked (as it is reminded on the card).

Messages.Author: Bloodartist
Messages.Body:
> Yomyael wrote:
> Another question for this card:
>
> When do you have to tap "The Line"? When the action is anounced, or when it is succesful and the cost of the card has to be payed?
>
You usually want to tap the line after action is successful, so its not "wasted" if the action is blocked.

However, it make an action that is otherwise impossible, possible. For example a vampire has 1 blood, and wants to do an action card that costs 2 blood. The line can be used while announcing the action to make it cost 1 and thus be possible to perform.
